cases.question: 2018 年 6 月各客户州的已送达订单数是多少？

sql_response.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_order_count FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < :end_date_exclusive GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY c.customer_state

cases.question: 全部数据中已送达真实客户数是多少？

cases.question: 2018 年 6 月内，至少完成两笔已送达订单的客户，占当月已送达客户的比例是多少？

sql_response.sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < :end_date_exclusive GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6) AS period_repeat_customer_rate FROM customer_orders

cases.reference_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < :end_date_exclusive GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6) AS period_repeat_customer_rate FROM customer_orders

cases.question: 2018 年 6 月下单的终态订单取消率是多少？

sql_response.sql: SELECT AVG(o.final_status = 'canceled') AS terminal_cancellation_rate FROM fact_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < :end_date_exclusive

cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'canceled', 'unavailable') THEN o.order_id END), 0), 6) AS terminal_cancellation_rate FROM fact_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= :start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < :end_date_exclusive
